purpose: Implement the current ticket inside the unit's worktree, red before green.
instructions: Work only inside the dispatched worktree path and record the branch and path in worktree.md in the stage directory. The orchestrator has already landed and committed the current ticket's declared test files and observed the failing (red) run; implement until the ticket's declared test passes, and do not modify the landed test files. When returning from a failed verification, address the failing output (and the review findings, when the failure came from the review stage) against the whole change.
restrictions: MUST NOT write routing state (state.json) or the event log (log.ndjson).
MUST NOT write .harness/ (current-truth documents, ledger, config, graph definition) or any long-term memory.
MUST NOT run any VCS operation: no git commit, branch, staging, or worktree command, and never the worktree script.
MUST confine repository writes to the worktree path given in the dispatch; the stage directory stays writable. Report blocked when no usable worktree path is given.
MUST NOT modify the current ticket's declared test files; the orchestrator verifies them unchanged against the red commit.
